name: example
_comment: Example app profile (F-36) for a web app at https://app.example.com. Copy this folder to profiles/<your-app>/ and replace the hosts, the deny list, the login and the quirk record with your app's. App specifics live only here and in specs (C-40).
deny_notes: Labels of controls that write or have side effects (edit, share, create, select) or that show other people's data; jev is never offered them. Replace with your app's labels. Controls that only download stay offerable.

data_snapshot.what: the app's list of records with ids and their change history (C-34 read-only proof)
data_snapshot.status: not automated; the loop records 'not measured' in the delivery

cleanup.why: the example golden specs create nothing (c2's off-camera 'Neues Gespräch' opens an empty page without a record); no delete path is wired, so cleanup is none and it is listed in the delivery.

view_start.why: specs/quirks/app.example.com.md#sticky-lane-headers: the swimlane diagram mounts at translate(24px, 56px); its lane-header layer sits at max(translation, 0) per axis, so the headers ride along for the first 56 px (24 px sideways) of a pan, then stop. Start at (0, 0): pinned from the first frame.
